text:
User is compiling a supply order for the Harmore depot.
- Staff: Kira, Opal, Leon, Finn, and Wren are out. Nils, Bram, Cora, Esme, Dell, Greta, and Kira (covering Wren) are covering. Leon covers Bram.
- Desk swaps: Una/Cora, Leon/Bram, Wren/Cora, Teo/Hugo, Una/Kira.
- Maintenance/Noise: Lifts near harbour, print, north offices, and loading bay are slow. East wing cold afternoons (Cora) and mornings (Suri). North office repainting (afternoon noise). Loading bay repainting (evening noise). Harbour room repainting (evening noise). Garden studio cold afternoons (Nils). Library annex repainting (morning noise).
- Order: 540 (tarps), 580 (lamps), 590 (toolkits). Flat delivery fee: 60.
- Preferences: Leon, Hugo, Cora, Vik prefer library annex. Esme, Jonah prefer north office. Pia prefers loading bay. Una prefers garden studio.
- Clearances: Bram, Una, Dell, Ines, Cora, Leon want north office clear. Bram, Suri, Opal want library annex clear. Dell wants loading bay clear for visitors.
- Items: Umbrellas in garden studio, north office, loading bay, print room.
- Meetings: Evening stand-up moved to north office. Afternoon stand-up in east wing. Morning in north office.
- Coffee machines: East wing, garden studio, north office, loading bay working.
- Tasks: Send Mira notes from evening meeting. Send Nils notes from afternoon meeting. Answer Una’s query about north office evening availability. Answer Pia’s and Leon’s queries about loading bay evening availability.
